# Legacy Windows Package (Reference Only)

This folder is the original `VictoryVideoAgent_AllModules_Complete_v1_3_Windows.zip` (v1.3,
2026-06-08), preserved unmodified — both as the original zip and extracted — so the exact
reference behavior and visual output stay available to diff against as the web migration
proceeds. See [`../VIDEO_ENGINE.md`](../VIDEO_ENGINE.md) for the full inspection of what this
package does.

**Do not edit anything in this folder.** The live, refactored engine lives in
[`../engine/`](../engine).
